description: This file contains test support utilities and mock functions for testing the Feishu lifecycle integration in a TypeScript project. It includes functions to create mock runtime environments, simulate message events, and verify behaviors in tests.

methods.name: setFeishuLifecycleStateDir
methods.description: Sets environment variable for Feishu lifecycle state directory with a prefix and a UUID.

methods.name: restoreFeishuLifecycleStateDir
methods.description: Restores or deletes the environment variable for Feishu lifecycle state directory.

methods.name: createFeishuLifecycleReplyDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a mock reply dispatcher object with mock functions for testing.

methods.name: createImmediateInboundDebounce
methods.description: Creates a mock inbound debouncer with functions to simulate debounce behavior.

methods.name: installFeishuLifecycleRuntime
methods.description: Installs a mock Feishu runtime environment with provided parameters.

methods.name: installFeishuLifecycleReplyRuntime
methods.description: Installs a mock reply runtime environment with provided mock objects.

methods.name: mockFeishuReplyOnceDispatch
methods.description: Mocks a single dispatch of a reply with specified text and behavior.

methods.name: createFeishuLifecycleConfig
methods.description: Creates a configuration object for Feishu lifecycle with account and app details.

methods.name: createFeishuLifecycleFixture
methods.description: Creates a fixture object containing configuration and resolved account info.

methods.name: createResolvedFeishuLifecycleAccount
methods.description: Creates a resolved account object for Feishu with given parameters.

methods.name: createFeishuTextMessageEvent
methods.description: Constructs a mock text message event for Feishu.

methods.name: replayFeishuLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Simulates replaying a Feishu lifecycle event twice with specified handler.

methods.name: runFeishuLifecycleSequence
methods.description: Runs a sequence of asynchronous delivery functions with waits in between.

methods.name: expectFeishuSingleEffectAcrossReplay
methods.description: Asserts that a mock effect is called a specified number of times across event replays.

methods.name: expectFeishuReplyPipelineDedupedAcrossReplay
methods.description: Asserts deduplication behavior of reply pipeline across replays.

methods.name: expectFeishuReplyPipelineDedupedAfterPostSendFailure
methods.description: Asserts deduplication behavior after a post-send failure.

methods.name: expectFeishuReplyDispatcherSentFinalReplyOnce
methods.description: Verifies that the final reply was sent exactly once by the dispatcher.

methods.name: setupFeishuLifecycleHandler
methods.description: Sets up a mock handler for Feishu lifecycle events with account registration and handler retrieval.
